create_DeepseekVLHybridProcessor: create a DeepseekVLHybridProcessor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal input
call_DeepseekVLHybridProcessor: call the processor with text prompts and images to produce tokenized input_ids and pixel_values
decode_tokenizer_output: decode tokenized input_ids back to text strings using the processor's decode method
batch_decode_tokenizer_output: batch decode a list of tokenized input_ids back to text strings using the processor's batch_decode method
get_model_input_names: get the combined list of model input names from both tokenizer and image processor
